# Bloodlines

A bloodline is rolled once per player when they first join and can belong to any race. It appears in the **Trait** line of your character stats. You can be born without one.

## Bloodline catalogue

Each percentage applies to the named birth roll. An already assigned Akuma bloodline carries through to your character stats.

| Bloodline | How to get it | Known carriers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Will of D.](will_of_d.md) | 3% Haki Realm or 5.0% on Akuma’s roll | Roger, Luffy, Garp and Teach |
| [Kozuki Clan](kozuki.md) | 2% Haki Realm | Oden, Momonosuke and Hiyori |
| [Shimotsuki Clan](shimotsuki.md) | 3% Haki Realm | Ryuma, Koshiro, Kuina and Zoro |
| [Charlotte Family](charlotte.md) | 3% Haki Realm | Katakuri, Smoothie and Cracker |
| [Figarland Family](figarland.md) | 1% Haki Realm | Shanks, Garling and Shamrock |
| [Nefertari Family](nefertari.md) | 2% Haki Realm | Vivi, Cobra and Lili |
| [Kurozumi Clan](kurozumi.md) | 2.5% Haki Realm | Orochi, Kanjuro, Higurashi and Semimaru |
| [Monkey Family](monkey.md) | 1.5% Haki Realm | Garp, Dragon and Luffy |
| [Riku Family](riku.md) | 2% Haki Realm | Riku Dold III, Viola and Rebecca |
| [Portgas Line](portgas.md) | 1.5% Haki Realm | Rouge and Ace |
| [Ryugu Royal Line](ryugu.md) | 2% Haki Realm | Neptune, Shirahoshi and Fukaboshi |
| [Silvers Line](silvers.md) | 1% Haki Realm | Rayleigh |
| [Celestial Dragon Blood](celestial_dragon.md) | 5.0% Akuma | World Nobles |
| [Heavenly Demon](heavenly_demon.md) | Earned in play | Donquixote Doflamingo |

## Grafted Lineage Factors

A player with the [Nomi Nomi no Mi](../fruits/nomi_nomi_no_mi.md) can graft Lineage Factors onto another player. Grafts have their own capacity and can coexist with a bloodline. See [Borrowed Blood](../../reference/quests/r_traits.md#q-29161f26afbbc28c).

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| Stat | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Stable grafts | 3 |
| Maximum HP loss per excess graft | 10% |
| Weakening of every graft per excess graft | 15% |
| Grafts persist through death | Yes |

</div>
